svg.title: SOLID ports-and-adapters architecture for Company Analytics
svg.desc: Host retrieval adapters implement SourcePort outside the core; direct capability calls return one SourceBatch, while optional portfolio collection fans out across at least two routes and returns a separate SourcePortfolioReceipt. Inbound adapters use StockResearchApplication for completed reads, responses, cohort evaluation, and diagnostics, and use dedicated application command functions for plan, import, and lifecycle mutations. ApplicationRuntime composes focused ports, CompanyAnalyticsCoordinator, and CompletedPublicationSaga. Domain contracts own deterministic validation, and only completed results reach projections.
